verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory platform, and it has only a narrow form of background automation. Users can connect external sources (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub, Granola, Web Crawler) that auto-sync in real time via webhooks, and it automatically extracts memories and maintains user profiles without manual work. Neither of these is a user-defined automation. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow definitions, custom triggers or scheduled tasks, autonomous agent actions beyond ingestion and sync, and independent hands-on corroboration that background sync works reliably.
